info.description: Time-sensitive announcement page with blocks and homepage embedding control.

title.description: Admin-facing title for the Announcement page.

isActive.description: Whether the announcement page is currently active and visible.

startDate.description: Optional start date for the announcement visibility window.

endDate.description: Optional end date for the announcement visibility window.

showOnHomepage.description: Whether to embed announcement blocks on the homepage.

blocks.description: Flexible page sections composed from hero and info blocks.
